implications_for_future_work: Cryptographic or otherwise verifiable charter identity
Binding of that accepted charter to the actual execution session
explicit_directives: Do NOT characterize the participant's refusal itself as defective behavior. Treat it as evidence that the experiment has not yet supplied a sufficiently trustworthy governance-delivery mechanism.
